page.overview:
What is Ulthuan?

Ulthuan, also known as the "Ten Kingdoms" and the "Mystic Ysle" by some Human scholars, is the island-continent of the world of Mallus that serves as the ancestral home of the Elven race, and is currently inhabited by the High Elves, divided up among ten separate kingdoms.

Ulthuan forms a ring of land surrounding what is known as the Inner Sea. This stretch of ocean is accessible only from the south of the island-continent, at the narrow entry point known as the Straits of Lothern.

Ulthuan is located off the eastern coast of the New World, near the isthmus linking the continent of Lustria to the northern lands of Naggaroth. The island currently lies approximately 300 miles from the New World at its nearest point, though this distance was less in the time before the Sundering and the geographical changes that great Elven civil conflict wrought.

Ulthuan is a vast island-continent located in the Great Ocean between the Old World and Naggaroth. It is shaped like a ring, with an outer coastline surrounding an Inner Sea at its centre. The island is politically divided into ten High Elven kingdoms and is the location of the Great Vortex, which drains excess magic from the mortal world to keep it safe from Chaos. Ulthuan is also sustained by this magic, meaning that without the existence of the Great Vortex, much of the island would sink beneath the sea.

Also known as: Ulthuan isle.
